title: Critique: a theory dividing experience from function cannot be tested

statements.text: Cohen and Dennett name local recurrency theory as the best-known theory that separates experience from cognitive function. Any neural theory built on that division can be neither confirmed nor falsified, since only the products of cognitive functions, such as report, let consciousness be studied at all.

sources.quote: we argue that any neurobiological theory based on an experience/function division cannot be empirically confirmed or falsified and is thus outside the scope of science
The best-known theory that embraces the separation between experience and function is the local recurrency theory put forth by Lamme
